title: 4chan whistleblower: higher-ups think the visitors treat Earth like a zoo

tellings.quote: that they just don't care about us. Like, they just don't care. They don't care. It's more like a zoo where they're

plain: The people at the top who know about the visitors supposedly believe the visitors simply "don't care about us" and treat Earth "more like a zoo". The magician and YouTuber Chris Ramsay tells Michels this, passing on the claims of an anonymous "whistleblower" who posted a thread on 4chan, an anonymous online message board. If true, the visitors would be watching humanity the way we watch caged animals, and not getting involved.
